canada.summary: Daniel Choi, the owner of Daniel's Art Supplies, says the Toronto building he partly leases has been sold and renovations are coming.

canada.title: N.S. premier doubles down on complaint to professor over AI data centre comments
canada.summary: Premier Tim Houston says he's glad his communications adviser sent a critical email to a professor who commented on a proposed data centre. Houston claims Sibo Chen was "clearly lacking information but yet speaking as an expert." Chen suggested the email was meant to intimidate him.

canada.title: Toronto housing market faces fresh uncertainty after Bank of Canada rate hike, real estate experts say
canada.summary: The Bank of Canada said this week's hike is aimed at reducing the risk of high global oil prices spreading to other products, and signaled that further rate hikes might be on the horizon. Real estate experts say this could slow the GTA housing market even further.

canada.title: As N.B. reconsiders fracking, here’s how science and tech have evolved since the moratorium
canada.summary: As the New Brunswick government reconsiders its moratorium on natural gas development, opponents say there’s now stronger science that it’s harmful, while proponents say there are also safer ways to do it.

canada.title: Province defends N.B. Power selling surplus electricity at market rates outside New Brunswick
canada.summary: The New Brunswick government says N.B. Power selling excess electricity at market prices outside of the province benefits the utility and its customers, and it has no plans to order the Crown corporation to sell the same power to local industries at a price discount instead.

canada.title: N.S. Liberal leadership candidates meet for final debate
canada.summary: The candidates vying to be the next leader of the Nova Scotia Liberal Party used the contest's final debate to make their most direct appeal yet to delegates for why they should be their choice.

canada.title: Community centres stretched thin at the front lines of a changing world, but not giving up
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador's community centres have become a one-stop shop to address the province's increasing need for social support. CBC visited two locations at the front lines who say they need more resources.

canada.title: 'Horror fanatic’ gets into Halloween spirit, raising donations with haunted house
canada.summary: One home in the east end of St. John’s has been turned into a house of horrors, and for a donation, people are welcome to drop by and get a fright.

canada.title: More Canadian provinces are ending time changes. What does it mean for your health?
canada.summary: Researchers are raising concerns as parts of Canada move to permanent daylight time, warning that later winter sunrises could have consequences for sleep and health.

canada.title: He tried to get into Montreal's kosher market. It led to a battle over alleged meat monopoly
canada.summary: Mendy Boyarsky alleges the Jewish Community Council of Montreal (JCC) is using its market dominance to limit competition to the kosher meat market through its certifier, Montreal Kosher, known as MK Kosher. He asked the federal Competition Tribunal to step in. The JCC, which runs MK Kosher, denies the allegations.

canada.title: As military housing expands in Shannon, Que., mayor calls for urgent action on traffic
canada.summary: The City of Shannon, Que., is calling for changes to address traffic along Bravoure Road before over 1,000 new housing units are built for soldiers of the nearby military base — CFB Valcartier.

canada.title: 'It feels fantastic,' Scott Gillingham says after winning another term as Winnipeg mayor
canada.summary: After winning his second consecutive term as Winnipeg mayor, Scott Gillingham says the city's best days are still to come. He had 39.8 per cent of the ballots cast, with all polls reporting just before 10 p.m. Wednesday.

canada.title: 'Time for change': Lora Meseman takes Transcona seat from Russ Wyatt, incumbent facing sex assault charges
canada.summary: Russ Wyatt, facing two sexual assault charges and three drug charges, will no longer represent Transcona on city council, after suffering his first electoral defeat in more than two decades.
